Hmm? What's the matter, Trainer?
You seem a little spaced out.

Even when other girls are on edge or feeling crushed by
the pressure, Tannhauser stays toootally unfazed!
—Next up is an exhibition race on the 1800m turf. What kind of developments await on a track roughed up by last night's rain?!

It's been almost 20 minutes already. If I were being chased for that long,
I'd probably feel completely cornered...

Even if she does not obtain the results she hoped for, she does not cry. She remains positive.
...Did you not catch a glimpse of that aspect during her training?
Mihono Bourbon takes the lead! An overwhelming victory at the finish line!

No way, you kept pace until like the last 300 meters.
That's pretty darn impressive.

I think the turf caught my footing.
Guess my muscle strength was just lacking. ...Somehow...
Indeed, looking back on it now—
Troubled? ...About what?
Ah~, yeah, totally get it.

A strength that allows her to steadily forge ahead precisely because her composure never wavers.
Without anyone noticing, she possessed such a quiet resilience.
Putting the "parents" thing aside... I felt like I had finally begun to understand Machikane Tannhauser's hidden "greatness".

With high expectations on her shoulders, the exhibition race began.
However—
Machitaaan! Go for it—!
Ah. This carrot is super yummy~!

All of a sudden I'm hungry! I'm gonna head to the cafeteria!
Mhum, what should I eat? Today feels like an udon day~.

It's actually a pretty big deal, but nobody really notices.
Even she doesn't really get it.
She might be like this, but please take good care of Tannhauser-san.
Woow... you guys kinda sound like my "parents", y'know?

Today was the day of the exhibition race. The lineup was full of formidable opponents,
including Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower.

Unfazed by my worries, Machikane Tannhauser casually ordered her lunch
and began eating without even bringing up the upcoming race.

The final stretch! Mihono Bourbon opens a huge lead. Rice Shower
fights hard, but Machikane Tannhauser fails to make a push—

So... yeah! I'm not agonizing over it anymore.
Though I do wanna rethink what to do for my solo training from here on~

Swept along by Twin Turbo's voice, the surrounding Umamusume
each began shouting their support for Machikane Tannhauser as well.

It appears the quiet accumulation of Tannhauser-san's
'unexpected aptitude' is gradually starting to spread.

Carrying so much expectation only to end in a lackluster result. There is no way she isn't in shock.
Thinking I should bring her to the Trainer's office for a debrief—

Machikane Tannhauser is, for better or worse, not the type to stand out.
I figured those around her wouldn't expect much in the way of victory, but—

I know, right?
She kept right up with Bourbon and Rice during training, too!

One, two, three, four! Two, two, three, go!
Three, two, three, four! Four, two, three, go!

How your Trainer felt.
You thought to yourself, "Why are they so totally ordinary...?", didn't you?
H-Huh? Wait, are you praising me right now?

While applause erupted for Mihono Bourbon, an indescribable
awkwardness hung in the air among the Umamusume who had rooted for Machikane Tannhauser.

Whoa, that's a lot of cheering!
...All right, I'll do my best! I am so totally... gonna win!

Machitan was kinda, like, more... underwhelming than I thought.
It ended without her ever really having a spotlight moment, huh.
Oh, hey everyone! ...Wait, what do you mean you get it?

Oh, Machitan's running!
I heard she was amazing during that game of Cops and Robbers in training.

Mihono Bourbon leads by five lengths, six lengths, seven lengths!
The battle for second place is total chaos!

Ahaha, I'm okay, totally okay!
My legs are just shaking. ...Guess I've still got a long way to go~
Seeing that she hadn't caught on at all, I carefully chose my words to explain—

Oh, I get it! Well, yeah, of course I was pretty bummed
that I lost... But that just means I'm not strong enough right now, you know?
Machikane Tannhauser had always been 'ordinary.'

*pant, wheeze, pant, wheeze*...!
No waaaay, I can't let it end like this~! Cut me some slaaack~!
Time to dig innn!

*sigh*... I'm so sorry, Trainer.
Looks like I've still got a ways to go~
